title: Agent permissions on one computer (agents.json in the app data folder)
description: What agents may do (AGT-03, D-145). Missing, invalid, or changed outside the app: nothing is allowed. Deleting, visibility changes, and sharing are never available to agents, so they have no setting. Not a boundary against programs running as the same user.

connect.description: Agents can connect. Off: the server refuses to start

readPublic.description: Read public notes (notes/). On by default, once agents can connect

edit.description: Create and edit notes. Editing a note also needs reading its root

createPublic.description: Create public notes; otherwise new notes are private

folders.description: Limit to folders: "all", or workspace-relative folders under notes/ or private/notes/, spelled as the app accepts them (agentPath). An empty list allows nothing

check.description: SHA-256 of the permissions as the app wrote them. A file whose check doesn't match was changed outside the app, and the defaults apply
